title: Caregiver Contact Drill Completion Rate
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:checkin drill_name=* completed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(completed="yes",1,0))) as matched by drill_name
| eval a_completed_drill_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_completed_drill_pct
description: Measures the percentage of caregiver contact drills that end with a completed drill by drill.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which drill are helping or hurting caregiver contact drills.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a completed drill` on `care:checkin` events and summarize the hit rate by `drill_name`.
visualization: Table of drill with percentage of caregiver contact drills ending with a completed drill.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how often a completed drill happens for each drill so you can see where caregiver contact drills go smoothly or get stuck.
